# Three.js 0.160.0

Unmodified `build/three.min.js` and MIT `LICENSE` from the official npm package
`three@0.160.0`, https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.160.0.tgz.
The downloaded tarball was verified against the npm registry's SHA512 integrity
metadata before these two files were selected without extracting archive paths.

JavaScript SHA256: `170c6789f43217c96b3170f4b42fafe135de7f7cd48497a4218f9757ee1d49fa`.

Keeping the exact existing version locally removes a required CDN request from
the workbench's startup and permits offline scene rendering.
